ratings_why.fun: Every tier has a clear job and the board grows in a shape I want: small clicks early, Heat piling up mid-game, then Furnace, Nutrisco or Ottilie turn it loose late.
ratings_why.distinct: Scorch that carries into the next fight, Heat on any tribe's unit, and Regrow that halves itself play unlike today's tribes, though Heat-reading payoffs are a familiar counter pattern.

verdict_why: Nothing is broken or unreadable; the hot spots are the owner's to balance, and more passes would mostly reshuffle numbers.

points.text: Guild Assayer wipes the Heat that every other card reads, so in most builds it is a trap at Tier 3. Letting it cash in only half the Heat, or only a unit you then sell, would make it a real timing choice.
Tiers 4-5 dip: a flat +1/+1 Reforge is small there and Spotted-Belly Barker is the only stat payoff before Tier 6. One more Heat-to-stats card at Tier 4 or 5 would smooth the climb.
Slag Row Journeyman usually carries only 1-2 Scorch, so it plays like a vanilla 3/3. It could also gain Attack from Scorch on the units beside it, to pay off the burn build.
Bellows-Boy's forced spend fights saving for Tier up. Spending only gold left over once you are at 5+ unspent would keep it a fuel source without punishing a level turn.

standouts.why: Ottilie makes every high-Heat unit come back stronger, and the halving keeps it a fight you can still win against.
Ember-Belly Newt turns self-damage into Attack and kills Scorched units on purpose for Regrow: the tribe's best decision card.
Masterpiece Hall Assessor gives Heat clear goals (Shield, Cleave, Swoop) that drop as the unit Regrows, so each comeback is weaker.

weakest.why: Guild Assayer spends the tribe's main resource for a one-off buff that later cards would have multiplied.
Slag Row Journeyman rarely has enough damage on it to beat a plain body.

flags.note: Keeper of the Never-Out Furnace makes growth quadratic in Heat; at 60 Heat and 8 Reforges a turn it adds over 120 stats a turn.
Nutrisco gives +3 per Heat in fight on a carry that may also have Shield, Cleave, Swoop and Regrow; worth a sim on constructed late boards.
Crested Konrad copies a Fly South Bird's Heat every time it is sold, so Heat duplicates across turns.
Slag Gatherer triggers on 0-gold Created units, so any neutral that makes units cheaply becomes free Reforges.
